svg.title: Raccoon Cloud mascot
svg.desc: Friendly raccoon with glowing Kubernetes visor, cloud silhouette, and one-, two-, or three-node homelab hardware. Click or focus the nose and press Enter or Space to change layouts. Brush past the hanging cables or scroll to set off springy vine-like ripples and gravity nudges.

path.aria-label: Change homelab node layout; currently three nodes

g.aria-label: Two compute nodes and a tall hot-swap NAS
